'''Arceus''' (Japanese: '''アルセウス''' ''Arceus'') is a [[Mythical Pokémon]] who appeared in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga.

==History==
==={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}===
[[File:Arceus Multitype Adventures.png|thumb|left|220px|Arceus and each of its types]]
Arceus first appeared in a flashforward in ''[[PS442|Out-Odding Oddish]]'', battling against {{adv|Gold}}. It made its first actual appearance in ''[[PS450|With a Little Help From Hitmonchan]]'', having been awakened by Team Rocket at the [[Hall of Origin]] and having come to the [[Johto]] region due to all of its [[Plate]]s being currently located there. {{adv|Crystal}} decided to try {{pkmn2|caught|catching}} it, but Arceus proved to be too strong and escaped. Crystal tried to pursue it and was soon blasted out of the sky.

[[PS451|Soon after]], Arceus appeared at the [[Ecruteak Gym]] and promptly destroyed the building. Gold attempted to battle it, but Arceus easily pushed away [[Exbo]]'s {{m|Blast Burn}} before flying away to the [[Ruins of Alph]]. Upon arriving at the ruins, Arceus formed a barrier around itself and Gold, forcing him to battle it. Soon {{adv|Silver}} appeared at the site too, having collected all 16 Plates. Sensing them, Arceus transported everyone in the area to the [[Sinjoh Ruins]]. Upon arriving, Team Rocket captured Arceus and forced it to the Mystri Stage. [[Archer]] used the Plates to take control Arceus and "forced" it to summon {{p|Dialga}}, {{p|Palkia}}, and {{p|Giratina}}.

The [[Pokédex holder]]s attempt to stop Arceus's summoning process, but even though it momentarily seemed like they had succeeded in this, Arceus finished summoning the [[Legendary Pokémon]] as soon as it was done absorbing the Plates. [[Lance]] revealed that Arceus had been intending to summon the three [[Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Pokémon of myth]] regardless, as a test to see if humans could stop their fight and save the world. Gold attempted to help Arceus regain its faith in humanity, and eventually succeeded after bonding with his {{p|Togekiss}}, [[Togebo]]. Satisfied with Gold's connection with his Pokémon, Arceus stopped the battle between the trio and transported everyone back to the Ruins of Alph before taking its leave.

==={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===
Arceus appeared in a fantasy in ''[[PS437|The Final Dimensional Duel VII]]'', where [[Palmer]] thinks about Pokémon that can use {{cat|Moves that change type|moves that change types}}.

==Personality and characteristics==
Arceus once lived in harmony with humans, but was betrayed when humanity stole Arceus's power and converted it into the Plates. Due to this, it grew to mistrust humanity. It began to exhibit strong hostility towards them, sometimes attacking them on sight unprovoked. Despite this, Arceus wished to see the good in humans again, waiting for one to show it their heart and end its suffering. After seeing Gold bond with his {{p|Togekiss}}, Arceus begun to regain some of its trust in humanity.

Arceus is a very powerful Pokémon, managing to defeat the [[Pokédex holder]]s of [[Johto]] without much effort. Its [[signature Ability]], {{a|Multitype}}, allows it to become any [[type]] it wishes using the Plates, consequently changing the type of its [[signature move]], {{m|Judgment}}. When it is at the Mystri Stage in the Sinjoh Ruins, it is able to summon a swarm of {{p|Unown}} and create {{adv|Pokémon of myth|Dialga, Palkia, and Giratina}}, emphasizing its status as the [[Pokémon category|Alpha Pokémon]].
